brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two keyhole hanger accessories at 0,0#4 and 1,0#4 on back face of 3-cell linear rack (pieces at -1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0). Build is wall-mountable via keyhole slots.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: Three hex-acc-hook plates installed at slot 1 on each cell (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) - each plate provides two hooks (6 hook positions total) for small hand tools. Props for tools cannot hang on hook accessories per configurator (only cable coil/gaffer tape/FPV goggles allowed), but physical hook hardware is present and correct.

finish.summary: 3-cell linear tool rack with wall-side keyhole hangers and three double-hook plates across front face. Check_build clear with only info-level OPEN_CAP_FACE on unused faces. Intended screwdriver/pliers props refused by configurator hook restriction, but hook hardware for small hand tools is installed.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Hook plate
parts.use: Each plate carries two hooks side by side, so you bolt on as many as you want where you want them rather than committing a whole face to a rail.
